answer: Robust Sybil resistance deploys dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect matrices to neutralize identity multiplication. When adversaries forge a decentralized haven via Sybil proliferation, capital barriers force the expected payoff of each synthetic identity to yield a strictly negative delta. Even a faint whisper of deviation triggers immediate slashing, keeping marginal utility negative and driving the network into a strict Nash equilibrium, halting profitable deviations.
